name: Automated Data Import Framework
description: The Automated Data Import Framework (hereafter referred to as ADIF), is an expansible and generalized wrapper for API accessible data sources, as well as a docker setup that should make setting flatfiles up as API sources a breeze.

system-settings.name: API caching: enable caching of API responses. Projects then choose which of their API sources to cache. When unchecked, nothing is cached on this server: every request goes to the API, whatever projects have chosen.
Widest sharing allowed for cached API responses

choices.name: Across projects, for public data from keyless sources (default)

system-settings.name: Data tables: largest file a project can upload, in MB. Leave blank for the default of 8 MB. The server's PHP upload limits still apply when they're lower.

Most storage one project's data tables can use in total, in MB. Leave blank for the default of 32 MB. Lowering it doesn't remove tables already uploaded; it blocks new uploads until the project is back under the limit.

project-settings.name: Input the base URLs of any APIs which you would like to make available to your project.

sub_settings.name: Endpoint to check for a schema (optional). It's added to the URL above the same way a field's path is, and can use [field_name] placeholders, e.g. cwsq-ngmh.json?locationid=[census_tract_geoid]
Please provide the API schema, or use Detect schema to read it from the API.
If this source needs an API key, input it here.

Caching: cache this API's responses. Each response is stored as imports request it, and identical requests reuse it instead of calling the API again. Has no effect if API caching is turned off for this server. The settings below apply only to cached sources.
When should ADIF call this API?

choices.name: Only for data not already stored (default)
When stored data is older than a set number of days

sub_settings.name: Refresh stored data older than this many days

choices.name: Use the last stored value and note it in the module log (default)
Leave the fields blank and log an error

sub_settings.name: Data version (optional), e.g. 2023. Changing it makes ADIF fetch fresh data instead of reusing data stored under the old version. Recommended for versioned data such as ACS releases.

The record values piped into this source's [placeholders] are public codes (e.g. census tract IDs), not identifying information such as addresses. Leave unchecked if unsure: identifying requests are cached only within this project, under one-way hashed keys.

choices.name: With other projects on this server (public, keyless sources only)
